Precise Meteorological Forecasting System for Rocket Launch Sites
The refined meteorological monitoring and warning system for rocket launches at sea is designed to meet the meteorological services required for small, mobile r

The refined meteorological monitoring and warning system for rocket launches at sea is designed to meet the meteorological services required for small, mobile rockets launched at sea. Its main core functions include detailed resource assessment, three-dimensional meteorological rolling prediction, error analysis and correction, and feedforward control during the rocket's operation. During the resource planning stage, it can intelligently identify and rank the optimal launch locations based on the specific marine-meteorological environmental characteristics of the user's rocket launch area; during the service stage, it can provide three-dimensional atmospheric monitoring and rolling prediction during the launch window period to help narrow the range of the launch window; during the launch stage, it offers high-frequency rolling monitoring and warning of the marine meteorological environment, refining the rocket launch window period and achieving feedforward control.
